plates.prompt: Create original first-grade English reading-corner illustrations. Fine paper grain, matte gouache, clean cut-paper shapes, warm cream, deep pine green, apricot and persimmon details. Warm wooden reading room, low visual clutter, soft daylight, no words, letters, digits, logos or marks. Use novel fictional fabric puppets: Hazel is a little burnt-orange squirrel with a broad curled tail and pine-green scarf, Nori is a grey badger with a cream snout, black facial stripes and a golden vest. Friendly natural fabric silhouettes, keep subjects recognizable at 200 pixels. Exact 2 by 2 grid of equal square independent illustrations, no blank gutters. Top left: Hazel squirrel enters a children's library reading corner and waves to Nori badger across a low pale wooden desk, front view, friendly eye contact; one blue book on desk. Top right: Nori badger leans and points under a very clear side view of a small wooden desk; a single large persimmon-red spring clothespin rests on the floor entirely beneath the desk top between the legs, clearly separated from the desk. Hazel looks down. Bottom left: the two puppets sort cloth props together, pine reading bench and open blue fabric tote with visible opening at right, Hazel resting a paw on its rim; no other props piled around it. Bottom right: at a home reading table, two six-year-old Chinese children play with a little paper squirrel and a plain open pine-colored cardboard box, one holds a red spring clip and one looks on, calm.
